claim: `my_add_comm` restates core `Nat.add_comm` verbatim (its proof is literally `Nat.add_comm a b`) and is also a special case of the generic `add_comm`, so it adds nothing to the library.
requested_change: Remove `my_add_comm` (and with it the file `Mathlib/Algebra/MyNewProofs.lean`); use `Nat.add_comm` or `add_comm` at call sites.
evidence: diff: `theorem my_add_comm (a b : Nat) : a + b = b + a := Nat.add_comm a b`. Mathlib already relies on core `Nat.add_comm` (Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Nat/Defs.lean:36 `add_comm := Nat.add_comm`), and the generic additive form of `mul_comm` is declared at Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Defs.lean:225.

claim: The new file has no copyright header, no `module` line with `public import`s, and no `/-! ... -/` module docstring, so it fails the Mathlib header linter and does not match the module-system layout every neighbouring file uses.
requested_change: If any content is kept, start the file with the standard `/- Copyright (c) YYYY ... Released under Apache 2.0 license ... Authors: ... -/` block, then `module`, `public import`s, and a `/-! # Title ... -/` module docstring describing the file.
evidence: diff: file begins directly with `import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Basic`. claim: The declaration name `my_add_comm` and the file name `MyNewProofs` are placeholders that say nothing about content and ignore Mathlib naming (a `Nat` lemma belongs in the `Nat` namespace under `Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Nat/` or `Mathlib/Data/Nat/`).

evidence: diff: `theorem my_add_comm (a b : Nat)` in new file `Mathlib/Algebra/MyNewProofs.lean`; the existing Nat additive-structure file is Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Nat/Defs.lean.
